optimizations.title: Dell SupportAssist
optimizations.description: Dell's support app: hardware scans, driver offers and an always-on local web service that Dell's website talks to. Switch it back on (Restore default) before running Dell diagnostics or contacting Dell support.

checks.note: {text}, so BIOS updates don't depend on SupportAssist.
{text}. SupportAssist may be how this PC gets BIOS and driver updates; keep it unless you update from Dell's website yourself.

optimizations.title: Dell Update
optimizations.description: Dell's own driver and BIOS updater, running in the background.

checks.note: {text}, so Dell Update isn't needed for BIOS updates.
{text}. Dell Update may be the only way this PC gets BIOS updates. Keep it, or update the BIOS from Dell's support website yourself.

optimizations.title: Dell usage analytics
optimizations.description: Dell TechHub's analytics agent, which collects usage data for Dell. Nothing on your PC needs it.

optimizations.title: Dell device data collection
optimizations.description: Dell TechHub's data-manager and instrumentation agents, which gather device information. SupportAssist may use them for its scans, so keep them if you use SupportAssist.

optimizations.title: Dell Digital Delivery
optimizations.description: Downloads software you bought together with the PC (for example Microsoft Office). If you haven't downloaded that software yet, do it first; afterwards nothing needs this service.

optimizations.title: Dell Fusion service
optimizations.description: An older Dell client framework (FusionCore). It isn't part of Alienware Command Center, but which Dell apps rely on it varies by model. Test your Dell/Alienware apps after turning it off.

optimizations.title: Alienware lighting effects (AlienFX)
optimizations.description: Runs Alienware Command Center's lighting effects for RGB keyboards and Alienware accessories. Turn it off only if you don't use custom lighting; the keyboard then falls back to its built-in lighting.

optimizations.title: NVIDIA in-game overlay
optimizations.description: The Alt+Z overlay used for recording, instant replay, screenshots and the performance counter. Keep it if you use any of those. Driver updates keep working without it.
optimizations.manual:
This is a setting inside NVIDIA's own app, so Featherweight can't switch it for you.

NVIDIA App: Settings → Features → NVIDIA Overlay → Off (On to restore).
GeForce Experience: Settings → General → In-game overlay → Off (On to restore).

optimizations.title: Intel Graphics Software at startup
optimizations.description: Starts Intel's graphics control-panel app with Windows. The graphics driver itself is unaffected, and you can still open the app from the Start menu whenever you need it.

optimizations.title: Phone Link in the background
optimizations.description: Lets Phone Link run in the background to show your phone's notifications, messages and calls on the PC.

checks.note: {text}. Turning this off stops its notifications, messages and calls from reaching the PC.

optimizations.title: Microsoft PC Manager
optimizations.description: Microsoft's clean-up and "boost" app, running its service in the background. Keep it if you use PC Manager yourself.

optimizations.title: Hyper-V virtual machine manager
optimizations.description: Manages Hyper-V virtual machines and Hyper-V Manager. WSL, Windows Sandbox and Docker's WSL mode use a different service and keep working. If you start using Hyper-V Manager later, choose Restore default first.

checks.note: {text} on this PC. Turning this off would stop them from starting.

optimizations.title: Resume apps from your phone
optimizations.description: Windows' "continue on this PC what you were doing on your phone" feature. Some Windows versions still start its helper, so the memory gain can be small.

optimizations.title: Web results in Start search
optimizations.description: Bing web results when you search from the Start menu. With this off, Start search shows only things on your PC. It's mostly about clutter and privacy; the memory effect is small.

optimizations.title: Nahimic audio effects
optimizations.description: The Nahimic "sound enhancer" (virtual surround, voice and bass effects) that ships with some audio drivers. Sound keeps working without it; keep it if you like its effects.

optimizations.title: PunkBuster anti-cheat service
optimizations.description: An old anti-cheat service installed by some older games. It runs with full system rights all the time; games that need it start it themselves.
